Method.name: getPersonSearchResults
Method.Implementation: Set ..Adapter.WebServiceClientClass = "EnterprisePersonService.SOAP11Endpoint" Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("getPersonSearchResults",,pRequest.codeSystem,pRequest.SearchID,pRequest.Offset,pRequest.Count,.Result,.warnings) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set tSC = pRequest.NewResponse(.pResponse) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set pResponse.Result = $get(Result),pResponse.warnings = $get(warnings) Quit $$$OK
